# Marshall

[Grit](../codex/factions.md#grit)

## Overview

- **Age:** about fifty (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>
- **Gender:** male (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P34](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P54](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0054)</sub>

## Appearance

Marshall is an eccentric individual with long hair and a long beard. These distinctive physical features mark a notable change in his appearance within his social circle.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006)_

## Personality

Marshall is a stubborn, determined, and intelligent man with a notable temper, particularly when he hears of children being mistreated. Witty and well-read, he is a talented storyteller who possessed great skill as a dancer in his youth and is adept at singing old Scotch ballads in a fine tenor voice.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P15](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS CORNELIA MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017), +1 more_

## History

In his youth, Marshall was a noted dancer who was well acquainted with Miss Cornelia when he lived over-harbour. He famously made a public vow not to shave his face or cut his hair until the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) political party came to power, a strangely bearded appearance he maintained for years until the Liberals finally won a federal election and he shaved. Now married to Miss Cornelia, Marshall was consulted by his wife when [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) asked her to adopt the orphaned [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md). He agreed to the proposal, allowing Miss Cornelia to officially take Mary into their home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. ## Relationships

### [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--marshall.md)

Marshall Elliott is betrothed and married to Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md), a union that surprised members of their community when it was announced. The two maintain a collaborative partnership, consulting each other on major domestic decisions. This is demonstrated when Miss Cornelia checks with Marshall before officially agreeing to adopt young [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) into their home.
